description: This file defines the 'Education' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM system, used for reporting purposes related to employee education details. The class provides methods for normalizing and retrieving education-related data for a specific employee.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: A DTO class for representing employee education details in reports, providing methods to convert data into array form based on specified fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Education DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the employee's education data based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between field names and the corresponding getter methods for data extraction.
